title: Tientsin Incident

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 666
Date 28/10/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

October 28th 1916

Sir,
On the 25th inst the French Consul General sent to
the local Chinese Press a full explanation of the Tientsin
incident. On the evening of the same date representatives
of the Press held a meeting at which it was decided not to
publish the explanation as the action of the French
Authorities at Tientsin was a serious infringement of the
sovereign rights of the country. A reply to the
above effect will be sent to the French Consul General.

A deputation from the Rebels who have not yet been
paid, visited the Arsenal on the 25th inst and stated
that they could not wait until the 28th inst for payment.
They were curtly informed by a staff officer that no
more payments would be made until that date.
The patrols and sentries have been doubled on the roads
around the City and Arsenal.

Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：ATS）
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记册
编号 666
日期 1916年10月28日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探部））

1916年10月28日

先生：

本月25日，法国总领事向本地中文报界发送了一份关于天津事件的完整说明。同日晚，报界代表举行会议，决定不刊登该说明，理由是法国当局在天津的行动严重侵犯了本国主权。将向法国总领事发送一份表达上述意思的复函。

一群尚未领到薪饷的叛军代表于本月25日造访兵工厂，声称他们无法等到本月28日再领取薪饷。一名参谋军官冷淡地告知他们，在该日期之前不会再发放任何薪饷。

城区及兵工厂周边道路的巡逻队和哨兵人数已加倍。

您忠实的仆人，
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监上尉。

（批注：ATS）
